plain: To spread widely, as news or ideas

webster.text: Literally, to sow; to scatter seed; but seldom or never used in its literal sense.

more.text: To scatter for growth and propagation, like seed; to spread.

example.quote: The true policy of constitutions will be to increase the information of the country, and disseminate the knowledge of government as universally as possible.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, New York Convention, June 23, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
